ViewObject.Name: MaxJobLevel
ViewObject.SQLQuery: SELECT MAX(levels) AS job_max_depth FROM ( SELECT j1.job_id, CASE WHEN j10.job_id IS NOT NULL THEN 10 WHEN j9.job_id IS NOT NULL THEN 9 WHEN j8.job_id IS NOT NULL THEN 8 WHEN j7.job_id IS NOT NULL THEN 7 WHEN j6.job_id IS NOT NULL THEN 6 WHEN j5.job_id IS NOT NULL THEN 5 WHEN j4.job_id IS NOT NULL THEN 4 WHEN j3.job_id IS NOT NULL THEN 3 WHEN j2.job_id IS NOT NULL THEN 2 WHEN j1.parent_job_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS levels FROM JOBS j1 LEFT JOIN JOBS j2 ON j1.parent_job_id = j2.job_id LEFT JOIN JOBS j3 ON j2.parent_job_id = j3.job_id LEFT JOIN JOBS j4 ON j3.parent_job_id = j4.job_id LEFT JOIN JOBS j5 ON j4.parent_job_id = j5.job_id LEFT JOIN JOBS j6 ON j5.parent_job_id = j6.job_id LEFT JOIN JOBS j7 ON j6.parent_job_id = j7.job_id LEFT JOIN JOBS j8 ON j7.parent_job_id = j8.job_id LEFT JOIN JOBS j9 ON j8.parent_job_id = j9.job_id LEFT JOIN JOBS j10 ON j9.parent_job_id = j10.job_id ) t
